note: Natterwick's cast as data. goals and hard use the arrival ids from apps/api/src/director/craft.ts; stage is when the director may first make them central (see the goal pull rule); arc is three or four story-sized beats; marker is the one light regional word the character may use once a scene. cast.voice: Bright, young-adult (not childlike), gender-neutral, mid pitch, smiles audibly; slight hesitations when thinking; tracks the learner's stage speed.
